title.narrative: Access to financing solutions for Indonesia's Energy Transition Mechanism (ETM) enhancedThe Project aims to support PT SMI to mobilize USD 250mln from GCF for scaling-up of renewable energy in remote areas in Indonesia under ETM. ETM could potentially become a starting point for systematic transition to low-carbon for remote islands. The Project can scale-up at the regional level and replicated in other GGGI member countries.

title.narrative: O1.1 Number of completed advisory outputs that inform decisions on green growth investments

Technical advisory services provided to PT SMI in designing financial mechanismsIn order to fully operationalize ETM, PT SMI needs to develop various financial mechanisms. The Project will provide technical advisory services for conceptualizing and developing preliminary designs of i) sustainability linked-loan ii) financing facility for RE, iii) forex hedging facility through external consultants. This is a cross-cutting output and preliminary design of mechanisms will be incorporated into the concept note. The proposed output will be further developed during PPF implementation and finalized at the funding proposal stage.
